create_series_from_values: create a polars Series from a list of values with an optional name and data type
filter_series_by_boolean_mask: filter polars Series elements by a boolean mask preserving original order
cast_series_dtype: cast a polars Series to a different data type with strict or wrapping behavior
compute_rolling_window_stats: compute rolling min max mean sum std with fixed or time-based windows on a polars Series
fill_null_series_values: fill null values in a polars Series using a constant value or forward backward strategy
